title: Pool*Hot Tub*Grill*Game Room* Near ASU & Old Town
description: Welcome to your Tempe oasis, where laid-back vibes meet nonstop fun. Take a dip in the sparkling pool, then challenge your group to a game of poolside basketball/volleyball. Unwind in the hot tub or mix drinks and lounge at the outdoor bar. Fire up the BBQ grill and enjoy a meal in the dining area under the Arizona sky. Inside, the fun continues. The home features a dedicated game room with a pool table, an arcade room, and a poker table area ideal for friendly competition and late-night laughs.
